description: Since protocol 0.46: set up clangd for one of the user's own projects (phase 7.3), after a build for the board: write <project>/.clangd pointing at that build's compilation database (an ESP-IDF build's own; a sketch's mapped from arduino-cli's working copy to the user's files) and removing the GCC-only options clangd does not know. A .clangd the app did not write is left alone (an error says so). The result gives the --query-driver the user's editor must pass to clangd (esp32bench_build::clangd).

queryDriver.description: The glob of the cross-compilers, for clangd's --query-driver.
